relevance_note: Single-centre cohort of NOD2-confirmed Blau syndrome with per-patient rows in Table 1 and an individually described asymptomatic carrier: "A total of 14 individuals carrying pathogenic NOD2 variants causing Blau syndrome were initially identified".
method_note: Read the paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and copied spans from the Markdown (soft hyphens kept). The paper's genetics data are only in Supplementary Tables S1 and S2, which are not in the Markdown, so every variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported'; gene 'NOD2' and pathogenicity 'pathogenic' come from the named-group statement covering all 14 carriers. Thirteen included patients are indexed by bare numbers 1-13 in the unlabelled first column of Table 1 (data availability per time point), labelled 'Table 1 #k'; the Table 5 footnote names 'patient 7', so that person is labelled 'patient 7' (rule 1), assuming the footnote uses the Table 1/Table 4 numbering. The excluded asymptomatic female carrier (not in Table 1) is 'unnamed person 1'; whether she is a relative of a patient is not stated. Uveitis is recorded observed for all 13 from the statements that uveitis was diagnosed concurrently in 4 and after systemic features in the remaining 9 (inferred from group statement). Diagnosis basis and treatment summary are filled from statements about all included patients. Table 4 (treatment per patient) collapses all 13 patients into one row with stacked drug lists per time point; per D-31 these were not assigned to patients. Tables 2, 3 and 5 are counts per time point and assign nothing to individuals. Unnamed single-patient statements (e.g. 'One patient developed unilateral phthisis without light perception 11 years following onset of uveitis'; 'The only patient with monocular blindness (no light perception due to phthisis)'; two patients with corneal subepithelial opacities; acute angle closure glaucoma in two patients) were not attached to anyone; the phthisis/blindness statements probably concern patient 7, but the paper does not name the patient, so 'visual impairment or blindness' stays not reported for patient 7. Possible internal inconsistency: the Discussion says 'all patients in this series eventually developed panuveitis' while the Results restrict this to patients with uveitis lasting 10 years or more; panuveitis was not recorded per person. n_patients_reported = 14 (NOD2 carriers incl. the asymptomatic carrier); cohort_size_as_stated = 13 (included patients).
